# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

Keep project discussions respectful and free from harassment. Maintainers may
remove content or restrict participation that violates these standards.

Report conduct concerns privately to [yowainwright@gmail.com](mailto:yowainwright@gmail.com).
This policy applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, and other project spaces.
